P03.current_evidence: Deterministic edit detection now covers named time bands, named years, named new measures and corrections that rule a measure out; bare rain words were added to the vocabulary. Three recorded live multi-turn sequences answered with the right windows, years and measures; the detectors are pinned by 7 offline matrix checks. Reference resolution and paraphrase/holdout coverage remain open.

P04.current_evidence: Official sea-area and coastal text is reachable as published documents with page, issue and currency attached, while the marine tool returns modeled wave cells at the answering grid. Named sea-area identity, printed validity windows and a domain-reviewed specialist composition remain open; the recorded decision is not to invent a mapping.

P06.current_evidence: Watch requests are now handled explicitly: a local watch records place, hazard and window; it is checked only on request; a flood or cyclone watch is recorded as hazard_not_connected rather than mapped onto the district warning product; two live journeys show registration and a checked_no_match. Delivery, subscriptions, push and origin authentication remain open, and the CAP lifecycle never authorises dissemination.

P08.current_evidence: Historical district misses now offer source-lined place-index candidates (alternate spellings such as Mysore, and the district a settlement falls in such as Khurda) that require confirmation; two live journeys answered after selection and an unknown name kept the refusal. No reviewed dated crosswalk exists, so no automatic alias resolution is claimed.

P09.current_evidence: Stored forecast vintages were compared for 4,032 overlapping valid hours: mean absolute change 0.70 C for temperature, 3.98 percent for humidity, 0.94 mm for precipitation, with the largest change coming from two retrievals one second apart. This is vintage variance, not skill: upstream run identity is not exposed and no matched observations exist, so no accuracy, calibration or confidence number is produced.

P10.current_evidence: A bounded foreground daily cycle now chains document intake, an optional district sweep, watch checks, the retention report and health; a live national_bulletin cycle completed four steps in about 41 seconds. No daemon or schedule is installed; the recorded decision remains manual trigger now, scheduler later, and sustained cadence/throughput is unmeasured.

P11.current_evidence: A bounded queue (one active, three waiting, 45 s) with explicit refusal replaced instant rejection, and a cancellation endpoint with stage checkpoints discards a stopped turn's partial evidence; the page stop reports the server's own response. Stage streaming, queue position and pre-emptive cancellation of an in-flight model call remain open.

P12.current_evidence: The declared benchmark grew to 17 development cases (forecast, history, warning, document, agriculture, language, marine, river, aviation, adversarial, multi-turn) with the 4-case holdout untouched. The expanded live run: 18 declared tasks, 12 completed (66.7%), 6 incomplete, 0 missing, 0 prohibited claims, 0 critical failures; every incomplete is an honest partial or place selection. Still far below the docs/14 scale and one live pass.

P13.current_evidence: Voice component checks now pin measured-language filtering, the confirmable transcript with recognition-only confidence, and the refusal to speak an unmeasured language. A live round-trip measurement records place/unit/negation presence for Hindi and Gujarati, with numerals again observed as word forms and recognition probability null on this run. No speech accuracy, noisy-input or browser audio acceptance exists.

P14.current_evidence: A one-command verification (18 steps: environment, registries, drift guard, Python suite and five component suites), pinned dependency files, and a verified backup/restore path for conversations, watches, ingestion and the bulletin index. No CI service, container, off-machine copy or scheduled run exists; hosting and packaging for sharing remain on hold.

P15.current_evidence: A status drift guard now fails when READMEs recorded test count differs from pytest collection, when registry-named documents or evidence paths are missing, when a finding status is outside the vocabulary, or when ledger counts disagree with their rows. It found real drift on its first run and is part of scripts/verify_all.py.
